title: Rāmaṇeyyakaṃ
text: 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ Jetavane || || 2. Atha kho Sakko devānam indo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 3. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Kiṃ nu kho bhante bhūmirāmaṇeyyakan ti || || [page 233] XI. 2. 7.] DUTIYA-VAGGA 2. 233 Ārāmacetyā vanacetyā || pokkharaññā sunimmitā || manussarāmaṇeyyassa || kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ || || gāme vā yadivāraññe || ninne vā yadivā thale || yattha arahanto viharanti || tam bhūmirāmaṇeyyakan ti || ||
